content: Runaway agent spend is a documented failure: four LangChain agents with no step cap recursed for 11 days producing a 47000 USD invoice; a single runaway agent burned 2847 USD in 4 hours with all dashboards green. Dominant driver is O(N^2) context accumulation across rounds plus unbounded loops, not per-token price. Enforcement (terminate/pause before the next call) beats alerting (notify after spend). Recommended invariants: assert step <= MAX_STEPS, assert spent <= BUDGET_USD, assert input_hash(name,args) not in seen (loop/repetition detector). Context rot: accuracy drops 13.9-85% as context grows even when all info is present; Governance Decay (arXiv 2606.22528) shows compaction silently drops safety constraints from long-horizon agent context.
